answer: Verified Delay Ledger. Each new identity must hold a random juniper-marked task open for a mandatory cool-down before any reward clears; the ledger tracks that the same attention slot cannot back two identities at once. Compliance is checked against a rotating sonnet challenge the agent must answer inside each thread, proving live occupancy of that slot. An attacker farming N identities must staff N simultaneous waiting windows plus N challenge responses, so cost scales linearly with identities while honest single agents pay one window.
